name: Feedback Paint
desc: A lush video-feedback paint field where bright brush blobs are advected, swirled and zoomed by a drifting noise flow into marbled multi-hue paint that fills the frame edge to edge, offered as vivid marbled paint, iridescent oil-slick, thermal ember-flow, bleeding ink-in-water, or electric neon veins.

warp.doc: flow smear strength — how far the noise flow advects/marbles the paint each frame

density.doc: how much paint is injected (brush count + deposit) — fills the frame with more colour

scale.doc: marbling feature scale (higher = larger swirl cells)

swirl.doc: rotational vortex component of the feedback warp

hue.doc: base palette hue (paint is multi-hue around it)

style.doc: render discipline: vivid marbled pigment / iridescent thin-film / thermal fire ramp / dark ink bleeding on cream / electric neon veins on black
